symbols.name: SystemEndpointsOptions
symbols.summary: Configures the built-in system endpoint set.
symbols.remarks: The default group path is /_bdk/api/system and the default tag is _bdk.System. The root system route is mapped whenever the endpoint set is enabled, while the echo, info, and modules routes can be enabled or disabled independently. Example: var options = new SystemEndpointsOptions { InfoEnabled = true, ModulesEnabled = false, HideSensitiveInformation = true };

symbols.name: SystemEndpointsOptions()
symbols.summary: Initializes a new instance of the BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpointsOptions class with the default system group path and OpenAPI tag.
symbols.remarks: The constructor sets BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsOptionsBase.GroupPath to /_bdk/api/system and BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsOptionsBase.GroupTag to _bdk.System.

symbols.name: EchoEnabled
symbols.summary: Gets or sets whether the echo route is mapped.
symbols.remarks: When enabled, BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.GetSystem(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext) includes an echo link and BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.Map(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder) maps the echo route. The default value is true.

symbols.name: InfoEnabled
symbols.summary: Gets or sets whether the info route is mapped.
symbols.remarks: When enabled, BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.GetSystem(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext) includes an info link and BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.Map(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder) maps the info route. The default value is true.

symbols.name: ModulesEnabled
symbols.summary: Gets or sets whether the modules route is mapped.
symbols.remarks: When enabled, BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.GetSystem(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext) includes a modules link and BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.Map(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder) maps the modules route. The default value is true.

symbols.name: HideSensitiveInformation
symbols.summary: Gets or sets whether sensitive runtime and host details are hidden from the info response.
symbols.remarks: When enabled, BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.GetInfo(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext%2cSystem.Threading.CancellationToken) replaces host, IP, process, framework, machine, operating system, memory, URL, and timezone values with empty strings. Custom metadata and uptime remain visible.

symbols.name: CustomMetadata
symbols.summary: Gets or sets custom metadata included in the system info response.
symbols.remarks: The dictionary is returned as BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.SystemInfo.CustomMetadata by BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.SystemEndpoints.GetInfo(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext%2cSystem.Threading.CancellationToken). It can be used for non-sensitive application or deployment information that should be exposed through the system endpoint.
